description: This file defines data structures, constants, and function prototypes for recording and managing Postscript font hints (Type1/Type2) within the FreeType font rendering library. It includes definitions for hint descriptors, hint tables, masks, and functions for initializing and finalizing hint recording, as well as specific interfaces for Type1 and Type2 hints.

methods.name: ps_hints_init
methods.description: Initializes the hints recorder with given hints structure and memory context.

methods.name: ps_hints_done
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up the hints recorder.

methods.name: t1_hints_funcs_init
methods.description: Initializes the interface for Type1 font hints recording functions.

methods.name: t2_hints_funcs_init
methods.description: Initializes the interface for Type2 font hints recording functions.
